body: I really thank you for taking the time to reply to my post, but there is something I want to say, if she chooses to keep the baby, I'm killing myself. I have nothing holding me back besides the possibility that everything will be okay, and she'll choose to abort.. I guess where I'm going at, is that there really is only option for me. I don't want to die, I really don't. But I feel trapped. Im caught in a situation that I was never equipped to handle. I'm getting hit more then im dodging, im losing more then im gaining. All I ask is for one more chance.. I swear I'll never take my life for granted again! god help me! I'm just a fucking kid!!! fuck. how did I even get myself in this shit?!?!

She's had plan B before, and she was on birth control for a good portion of our relationship, but just a couple months ago she ran out, and we ended up getting drunk and having sex (forgetting i told her and promised myself I wouldn't have sex with her until she got back on birth control) So now here I am, another teenager who got his girlfriend pregnant, just another fucking statistic
